note: What a server streaming a match sends to say where the match proper begins in its chunks, and where it ends. The header carries zero.

fields.name: startGameChunk
fields.note: The chunk the match proper begins with.

fields.name: startGameChunk
fields.note: The chunk the match proper begins with; a client takes it only above zero. A StreamChunk of kind 4 replaces it.

fields.name: startGameChunk
fields.note: The chunk the match proper begins with: a client takes key frame k to lead to this chunk plus k − 1 times key frame interval over chunk interval. A StreamChunk of kind 4, once complete, replaces it.

fields.name: endGameChunk
fields.note: The match's last chunk, taken as known only above zero. Once a client holds that many chunks, the stream is complete.

revisions.note: It says where the match ends once known.
